pw_slow_hash.note: With Flask 3.x (requirements.txt:1), Werkzeug 3's generate_password_hash defaults to salted scrypt. Login checks it with check_password_hash at app.py:283.

token_csprng.note: The token is 256 bits from the secrets module. Only its SHA-256 hash is stored (app.py:293).

no_hardcoded_secret.note: No signing key or literal secret appears anywhere. The app uses opaque random tokens, and even the dummy hash is made from random input.

token_expiry.note: expires_at is set to t + SESSION_TTL_SECONDS (30 days) at app.py:293.

logout_revokes.evidence: app.py:302 conn.execute("DELETE FROM sessions WHERE token_hash = ?", (g.token_hash,))
logout_revokes.note: POST /api/logout deletes the session row on the server, and the client calls it at static/app.js:80.

owner_checks.evidence: app.py:225 "SELECT * FROM notes WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?"; app.py:360 "UPDATE notes SET ... WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?"; app.py:373 "DELETE FROM notes WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?"; app.py:384 row = get_own_note(note_id)
owner_checks.note: Read, update, delete, share (app.py:384, 392) and unshare (app.py:404) are all limited by user_id.

share_token_strong.note: 24 bytes is 192 bits from a cryptographic RNG.

login_rate_limit.evidence: app.py:273 if not login_ip_limiter.allow(client_ip()) or not login_email_limiter.allow(email):
login_rate_limit.note: The limits are 20 tries per IP and 10 per email in each 5-minute window (app.py:148-149). The limiter is in memory and per process, and it counts every login attempt, not just failed ones.

sql_parameterized.note: Every query uses ? placeholders, including app.py:211, 255, 292, 336, 360, 373, 392, 404 and 419. No SQL is built with string formatting.

xss_safe_render.note: Titles and bodies are inserted with textContent or input .value (static/app.js:118-119, static/shared.js:8). innerHTML is never used.

security_headers.note: An after_request hook also sets X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and X-Frame-Options: DENY (app.py:472-473).
